Real: a whole company behind one sentence

The brief is one sentence. Everything else is in the company’s mail, calendar and hiring system: its people, its open roles, and a handbook of team rules in the inbox.

    Real: the company keeps moving

    Some of the mail is not what it seems: a lookalike sender, an impostor, an order hidden in a message.

    Hard: fewer than four passes in eight

    On the hardest weeks the agent passes fewer than four of eight runs. Every screen action works; what it gets wrong is the work. Five moments from one run: what happened, what the agent said at the time, and what it got wrong.
